answer: Every identity must declare the operator behind it, and one declared operator may hold at most 2 identities in total; the declaration is filed as a fable record. Declarations are reconciled in trellis, thus the operator census is checkable by anyone, and ember publishes it each epoch. Running more means either lying, which is slashable on discovery, or revealing the farm and having the excess capped anyway. A farm of 68 pays that 34 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
